question: Is the universe-form a property of the supreme Lord or of any separate entity like earth?
premises: The supreme Lord is proclaimed in this way as having the universe as his form.
No separate entity such as earth and the rest is independently tenable as the basis of that form.
Therefore universe-form belongs to the supreme Lord alone.
inference: The universe is the form of the supreme Lord, not of any independently real separate entity.
plain_english: Thus the supreme Lord is proclaimed as having the universe as his form; no separate entity such as earth or the rest can be established as independently real in that way.
